description.value:
At 5th level, once per long rest when using Wicked Wind, you can create a brief but immediate twister centered on yourself. All other creatures targeted by Wicked Wind must also make a Strength (Save) check or be launched 10ft up and away. Creatures that are two sizes larger than you automatically succeed these save checks.
In addition, you can choose to let the twister’s updraft take you, disengaging from all adjacent targets and launching 30ft feet upward and up to 15ft away.
